scoring_justification: Metallicity, orbital occupation patterns, and spatial extent are recomputed from the raw DOS curves and numeric/text artifacts; no self-reported metric is trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold value for n-type spatial extent
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: 'for the n-type IF the 2DEG extends 7.8 Å perpendicular to the IF plane (completely on the STO side)'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: paper-reported experimental/computational result; the checker compares the agent's computed value to this reference with tolerance

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text describing O vacancy effects on n-type and p-type interfaces (metallicity, orbital character changes)
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived from the paper's results: n-type 25/50% remain metallic with Ti 3d carriers; p-type 25% metallic O 2p; p-type 50% metallic Ti 3d
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these patterns are the paper's explicit findings on O deficiency; the checker verifies the agent's summary matches them

outputs.description: Total DOS for the n-type interface; checker will verify finite DOS at Fermi level (metallicity).
Orbitally resolved Ti 3d PDOS; checker will confirm d_xy and d_xz,yz are occupied at EF while d_3z2-r2 and d_x2-y2 are empty, and d_xy occupation is larger.
Total and partial DOS for the p-type interface; checker will verify metallicity and O 2p dominance at EF with negligible Ti 3d.
Spatial extent of the n-type 2DEG on the STO side; checker compares to the paper-reported value within a tolerance.

schema.description: Free text with labels for n-type 25%, n-type 50%, p-type 25%, p-type 50%.

outputs.description: Textual summary of vacancy effects; checker verifies that all cases are metallic, n-type Ti 3d increased, p-type 25% O 2p-dominated, p-type 50% Ti 3d-dominated.
